'''April 2000 Monrovia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Monrovia, IN on 29 April 2000. [[Joe Fox]] won it. It is known from Joe Fox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00], DeckTech (Joe "JoeCool144" Fox, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Monrovia, IN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Fox]]
